page.overview:
Who is Jasmine?

Jasmine is a slender girl with fair skin and milky chocolate brown eyes. She has long straight light brown hair that reaches her waist with two orange beaded hair ties that tie two locks of her hair into short pigtails that stick up.

Jasmine wears a white sleeveless sundress that reaches her knees with a large white ribbon on her chest and white ankle-strap sandals.

Jasmine's appearance remains the same as it is in Gold and Silver.

She wears a teal sleeveless sundress with a bridal hem that reaches her knees with a snow white cardigan that reaches her waist and sleeves that go over her elbows, and is tied with an orange puffy bow. She also wears white sandals which have two teal decorations over the toes.
